contract.queues: Explicit FIFO capacities/work IDs/future inputs, per-queue logical clocks, disjoint pending queue/register reservations and cooperative bounded waits
contract.lifetime: Copy result with allocation/encoder receipt; checked once-only downstream reallocation; register replacement/queue init invalidate receipts, adjustments preserve identity
contract.control: Pause/resume retains pending request; stop/abort/budget failure releases reservations without another history ID; reject pending saves
contract.results: Exact 4-pose/10-measurement output resources, sparse writes and core shared cursor; explicit name-ID banks and logical process flags
contract.maps: Supplied finite point clouds, FALSE partial/zero center, replace-on-success/retain-on-failure, current-map clearing and independent future replies
contract.outbox: Retained copies of latest supplied completion and optional same-process supplied image registers; bounded IDs/bytes, no network or native schema
contract.persistence: Pure checked data for completed queues/receipts/maps/outbox and remaining inputs; no native/executable sessions

choices.choice: Milliseconds, negative indefinite wait and 117249 timeout are Pythonic choices aligned with the documented newer VT_GET_QUEUE; legacy reference leaves timeout units/status unspecified
Clear held parts/receipts, retain register values, clock and future external input plans
Portable local outbox of available supplied fields; no native transport, runtime-image freshness inference or invented telemetry

boundaries: Legacy VT forms can be unavailable on newer native controller versions despite offline translation support
No physical conveyor motion, acquired encoders, hardware triggers, camera map computation, autonomous detections or mobile delivery
Remaining VT allocation/acknowledgement, PATH queue editing, flow/time, tray and load-balancing calls remain unregistered; native/strict equivalence unverified
